d: Patna Encounter Updates: kya bihar men pulis jati dekhkar enkauntar kar rahi hai? tejasvi yadav, misa bharti aur bhaee virendr se lekar puri aarjedi pulis enkauntar ko jativad se kyon jor rahi hai? RJD ko kyon lagta hai ki bihar men enkauntar men muslim aur yadav samuday ke logon ko hi nishana banaya ja raha hai? kya apradhiyon ke enkauntar men bhi RJD apna siyasi votbaink talash rahi hai? saval islie kyonki pulis ki karravaee par jatiy bhedbhav ka aarop lagane vali RJD ko dusre mamlon men mare gae aaropiyon ki jati par bhi javab dena hoga...kyonki har enkauntar ki paristhiti alag hoti…
